causalGroups.firstCause: The functional fixture legitimately persisted Polish locale, while remaining search journeys still owned the English placeholder instead of the localized search combobox.
causalGroups.resolutionEvidence: All locale-mutating cross-country, filter, search, and journey tests passed together with zero retries.

causalGroups.firstCause: The tab regression hard-coded product ID 1 and assumed full analysis was already expanded; Nightly seeded the canonical full product at QA_PRODUCT_ID=2 in summary mode.
causalGroups.resolutionEvidence: All three desktop and mobile tab ownership tests passed against the exported product fixture with zero retries.

causalGroups.firstCause: Authenticated logout tests performed a real global Supabase sign-out on the shared fixture identity, revoking the stored session later consumed by the catalog and Firefox projects.
causalGroups.resolutionEvidence: Contained logout behavior, all 18 catalog cases, and all five Firefox primitive cases passed in project order with zero retries.

causalGroups.firstCause: The private-cache proof uses the locale-changing functional identity but owned English-only sign-out and sign-in controls.
causalGroups.resolutionEvidence: The complete account-isolation proof passed in the zero-retry owning-project run.

causalGroups.firstCause: The 600-second Playwright global cap was shorter than the workflow's existing 900-second comprehensive baseline and could not admit all 18 catalog cases plus Firefox and WebKit after earlier failures were removed.
causalGroups.resolutionEvidence: The cap now matches the 900-second comprehensive baseline, remains below the 20-minute workflow step cap, and is protected by a static contract test.

groups.firstCause: Filter count text uses theme-dependent foreground colors plus opacity over Nutri-Score and muted filter backgrounds, producing serious WCAG 1.4.3 failures in light and dark themes.
groups.proposedDisposition: Correct the semantic Nutri-Score foreground recipe and count styling without excluding Axe; prove light and dark contrast with focused component and browser coverage.
groups.resolutionEvidence: Focused component contracts passed; the zero-retry authenticated Axe suite passed all 12 tests with zero blocking violations in light, dark, and mobile search states.

groups.firstCause: The product now truthfully renders the heading 'Start by choosing 2–4 products to compare'; the test still expects the retired 'Select 2–4 products to compare' copy.
groups.proposedDisposition: Update the heading assertion to the current semantic role and copy; do not change product copy to satisfy the stale test.
groups.resolutionEvidence: The zero-retry failure-owning browser run passed the current semantic heading assertion.

groups.firstCause: The broad /Manual/i button locator matches both the exact 'Manual' mode control and the distinct 'Enter Barcode Manually' recovery action when camera fallback is present.
groups.proposedDisposition: Target the exact Manual mode control by role and accessible name, without positional locators or UI behavior changes.
groups.resolutionEvidence: The zero-retry failure-owning browser run passed all scanner lookup, result, validation, and navigation tests.

groups.firstCause: The Sign Up button correctly remains disabled until Turnstile succeeds; the local-only E2E tests attempt submission without a deterministic challenge token.
groups.proposedDisposition: Install a local in-page Turnstile API stub and local verification response for signup E2E only; retain production security behavior and hosted-egress blocking.
groups.resolutionEvidence: The zero-retry local-authenticated browser run passed both gated signup interactions while the egress proxy remained clean.

groups.firstCause: The functional fixture persisted Polish locale after cross-country tests; the filter helper looks only for an English placeholder even though the rendered combobox is correctly named 'Szukaj produktów'.
groups.proposedDisposition: Locate the search combobox inside its search landmark using its supported English or Polish accessible name; do not reset valid locale state or use positional selectors.
groups.resolutionEvidence: The zero-retry failure-owning browser run passed all executed desktop and mobile search-filter tests; two pre-existing data-dependent tests were intentionally skipped.
